findings.title: Do not skip installer verification when the Integration row is missing
findings.body: When no Integration exists for the supplied installation_id, this branch immediately advances the pipeline without comparing the authenticated GitHub user to the installer. The subsequent build_integration call fetches the installation using app credentials, which does not establish that the OAuth user owns it. Thus, if the installation webhook has not yet created the row (or the row was deleted), a user authenticated with an unrelated GitHub account can supply that installation ID and attach it to their Sentry organization. Missing installer information must fail closed or be verified through another authoritative source rather than bypassing the new security check.

findings.title: Handle integrations without sender metadata
findings.body: The new check unconditionally indexes integration.metadata['sender']['login'], but sender is optional in build_integration, and the basic installation flow in this PR explicitly creates metadata without it. If such an Integration remains after its OrganizationIntegration is removed, a subsequent installation attempt reaches this check and raises KeyError instead of rendering the invalid-installation response. Handle missing sender information explicitly and fail closed with the intended error page.
